scripts.dev: bash scripts/worktree-local-setup.sh --no-dev && source .worktree-local/config.env && PORT="$DEV_PORT" bun web-app:dev
scripts.web-app:docker:staging:login: aws ecr get-login-password --region us-east-1 | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin 422348803522.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com
scripts.web-app:docker:production:login: aws ecr get-login-password --region us-east-1 | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin 422348803522.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com
scripts.infra:staging:init: bun export-env && bun run --cwd infra terraform init -backend-config=envs/backends/staging.backend
scripts.infra:staging:plan: bun export-env && bun run --cwd infra terraform plan -var-file=envs/variables/staging.tfvars
scripts.infra:staging:apply: bun export-env && bun run --cwd infra terraform apply -var-file=envs/variables/staging.tfvars
scripts.infra:production:init: bun export-env && bun run --cwd infra terraform init -backend-config=envs/backends/production.backend
scripts.infra:production:plan: bun export-env && bun run --cwd infra terraform plan -var-file=envs/variables/production.tfvars
scripts.infra:production:apply: bun export-env && bun run --cwd infra terraform apply -var-file=envs/variables/production.tfvars
